security.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
security.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

evidence.explanation: Hard-coded credentials were detected in `src/main/resources/fileingestion.properties` for both RabbitMQ and SQL Server connection settings. The file includes static password values (`rabbitmq.password` and `db.password`) checked into source control.
